Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:10:1.english: To obtain permission - To speak about communal affairs.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:11:1.hebrew: מפני הדרכים - שנתקלקלו בימות החורף ומפני הגשמים, ועדיין לא נתקנו, ולא יוכלו עולי רגל לבא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:11:1.english: Due to the roads - Which became damaged during the winter days and because of the rains, and have not yet been repaired, and the festival pilgrims will not be able to come.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:11:2.hebrew: תנורי פסחים - שצולין בהם פסחיהם, ונמוקו בגשמי החורף, וצריכין חמה להתייבש:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:11:2.english: Ovens for the Paschal offerings - In which they roast their Paschal offerings, and [which] dissolved in the winter rains and need the sun to dry.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:11:3.hebrew: ומפני גליות ישראל - בני הגולה הרחוקים, ונשמע לבית דין שנעקרו ממקומן לעלות לרגל לעשות פסחיהם ועדיין לא הגיעו — שאם לא יעברוה, לא ירגילו לבא בפסח:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:11:3.english: And due to the exiles of Israel - The distant members of the Diaspora, and it became known to the court that they have departed from their place to make the pilgrimage to offer their Paschal offerings, and have not yet arrived — for if they do not intercalate [the year], they will not accustom themselves to come for Passover.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:11:4.english: Not due to the snow - For they will not refrain from coming on account of this.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:12:1.hebrew: גדיים וטלאין - שהן דקין, אין מעברין עליהן כדי שיגדלו ויעשו מהם פסחים, שהרי יכול להקריב קטנים:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:12:1.english: Kids and lambs - That are small: One does not intercalate [the year] on their account so that they will grow and Paschal offerings may be made from them, for one can sacrifice small [ones].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:12:2.hebrew: גוזלות - שצריכין לקיני יולדות שבכל א"י, וכן זבין וזבות, שכולן משהין קיניהם עד עלותן לרגל. אעפ"כ אין מעברין על כך, שיכולין להביא בני יונה, שכשרים כשהם קטנים:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:12:2.english: Fledglings - For they are needed for the bird-pair offerings of women after childbirth throughout the Land of Israel, and likewise [for] zavin and zavot, as all of them delay [bringing] their bird-pair offerings until their ascent for the pilgrimage Festival. Even so, they do not intercalate [the year] on that account, since they can bring young pigeons, which are valid when they are small.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:12:3.hebrew: אבל עושין אותן סעד - סייג וסמך לדבריהם לעבר את השנה, אם צריכה לעבר מפני א' מן הדברים שמעברין עליהן, כגון על האביב ועל פירות האילן. ואמרי' לקמן: "על שתים מהן מעברין, ועל א' מהן אין מעברין" — הללו, גדיים וטלאים וגוזלות, נעשו סעד ומצטרפין לאחד מהן, ומעברין:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:12:3.english: But they make them a support - A safeguard and support for their ruling to intercalate the year, if it needs to be intercalated on account of one of the matters for which they intercalate, such as on account of the spring [crop] or on account of the fruit of the tree. And we say below: "On account of two of them they intercalate, but on account of one of them they do not intercalate" — these, [namely] kids, lambs, and fledglings, become a support and combine with one of them, and they intercalate.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:12:4.english: And the time of the spring has not arrived - This is one of the signs for which they intercalate [the year], as [explained] below.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:1:1.english: By those who were invited for it - Whom the Nasi invited the evening before.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:1:2.hebrew: השכימו לי - מחר ז', לעלייה המיוחדת לישב בה בית דין:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:1:2.english: Arise early for me - Tomorrow, seven [of you], to the loft designated for a court to sit in.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:2:1.english: And I did not ascend to intercalate the year - To join with you now.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:2:2.hebrew: אלא ללמוד - תורה מכם, היאך תעשו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:2:2.english: Rather to learn - Torah from you, [namely,] how you will act.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:2:3.english: It was due to embarrassment that he did [this] - So that they would not recognize who was the one who had ascended without permission, and put him to shame.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:3:1.english: Who disturbed [my] father - That you ate the garlic and the odor wafted.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:3:2.hebrew: חס ושלום - שאוכל השום בבואו לבית מדרשו, אלא כדי שלא להלבין פניו של אוכל השום יצאתי, כדי שיצאו כולם ולא יבינו מי הוא:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:3:2.english: Heaven forbid - that [I] would eat garlic upon coming to his study hall! Rather, [it was] in order not to embarrass the one who ate the garlic that I left, so that everyone would leave and they would not realize who he was.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:5:1.english: From Shmuel HaKatan - As we said [above].

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:5:2.hebrew: אנחנו מעלנו - והוא לא נשא נכרית, והכניס עצמו בכלל שלא להלבין פניהם:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:5:2.english: We have broken faith - And [yet] he had not married a foreign woman, but he included himself in the collective so as not to embarrass them.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:6:1.hebrew: מיהושע - ממעשה דיהושע, שלא רצה הקדוש ברוך הוא לגלות לו מי הוא החוטא, והכניס את כולן בכלל, שנאמר: "חטא ישראל", במעשה דעכן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:6:1.english: From Joshua - From the incident of Joshua, for the Holy One, Blessed be He, did not wish to reveal to him who the sinner was, and He included all of them in the general statement, as it is stated: “Israel has sinned,” in the incident of Achan.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:6:3.hebrew: מאנתם - כולן בכלל. והרי כולן לא יצאו ללקוט אלא מקצת, דכתיב (שמות טז) יצאו מן העם ללקוט וגו':
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:6:3.english: Do you refuse - All of them are included [in this address]; and yet, not all of them went out to gather, but only some [of them], as it is written (Exodus 16:27): “...Some of the people went out to gather, etc.”

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:7:1.english: After the prophets died, etc. - [The Gemara] cited this here because of Shmuel HaKatan.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:1.hebrew: אף הוא - הוכיח סופו ששרתה עליו שכינה, שנתנבא בשעת מיתתו:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:1.english: He too - His end proved that the Divine Presence rested upon him, as he prophesied at the time of his death.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:2.hebrew: שמעון וישמעאל לחרבא - רשב"ג הנשיא ורבי ישמעאל בן אלישע כ"ג יהרגו בחרב:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:2.english: Shimon and Yishmael to the sword - Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel the Nasi and Rabbi Yishmael ben Elisha, the High Priest, will be killed by the sword.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:3.hebrew: וחביריו - כגון ר"ע ורבי חנניא בן תרדיון:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:3.english: And his colleagues - Such as Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Chananya ben Teradyon.

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:4.hebrew: לקטלא - לשאר מיתות: ר"ע במסרקות של ברזל בפרק הרואה (ברכות דף סא:); ר' חנניא בשריפה במסכת ע"ז (דף יח.):
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:8:4.english: To execution - To other [manners of] death: Rabbi Akiva with iron combs, in the chapter [entitled] HaRo'eh (Berakhot 61b); Rabbi Ḥananya by burning, in tractate Avodah Zarah (18a).

Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:9:2.hebrew: אלא שאין מספידין על הרוגי מלכות - מפני יראת המלך, מיהרו לקוברן:
Rashi on Sanhedrin 11a:9:2.english: Rather, as one does not eulogize those executed by the government - Out of fear of the king, they hurried to bury them.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:11:1.hebrew: מפני הדרכים והגשרים - והאי דלא חשיב ג' סימנין דלקמן — משום דעל שנים מהן מעברין, אבל הני, אפילו אחד מהני מעברין. ובברייתא דבסמוך גבי גדיים וטלאים וגוזלות שלא פרחו נמי לא חשיב להו — משום דאהנך דבסמוך, אפי' אשנים מהם אין מעברין עליו, אלא שעושין אותו סעד עם אחד מג' סימנים:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:11:1.english: Due to the roads and the bridges - And as for the fact that [the baraita] does not reckon the three signs [mentioned] below — [this is] because they intercalate [the year] on account of two of them, whereas [for] these, they intercalate even [on account of] one of them. And in the adjacent baraita regarding young goats, lambs, and fledglings that have not [yet] fledged, it likewise does not reckon them — because for those in the adjacent [baraita], even for two of them they do not intercalate [the year] on their account, but rather they make it a support [only] together with one of the three signs.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:11:2.hebrew: ומפני גליות ישראל שנעקרו ממקומן - משום דהנך דיתבי בא"י אין צריך לעבר, דאפי' האחרון יכול להגיע מר"ח ניסן עד פסח, כדתניא פ"ק דתענית (דף י.) גבי שאלת גשמים: ט"ו יום אחר החג, כדי שיגיע האחרון שבישראל לנהר פרת:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:11:2.english: "And due to the Diaspora Jews who have left their homes" - Because for those who reside in the Land of Israel, there is no need to intercalate [the year], as even the furthest one can arrive from Rosh Chodesh Nisan until Passover, as it is taught in the first chapter of Taanit (10a) regarding the request for rain: fifteen days after the Festival, so that the last [traveler] of Israel may reach the Euphrates River.

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:13:1.hebrew: רשב"ג אומר חדש - הכא משמע דחדש סתם הוא חדש חסר. וכן בפרק המדיר (כתובות דף עא.), גבי: חדש מלא וחדש חסר איכא בינייהו. וקשה, דבסוף החולץ (יבמות דף מח: ושם) אמרינן: ירח — שלשים, ימים — שלשים. וכן בפרק קמא דנזיר (ה. ושם) פריך: ואימא שלשים, כדכתיב: "עד חדש ימים"? וי"ל: דלשון תורה לחוד, ולשון חכמים לחוד. א"נ: הכא ובהמדיר, דקאמר ת"ק שלשים — מוכחא מילתא דאידך תנא חדש חסר (וע"ע תוס' כתובוח עא. ד"ה רבי):
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:13:1.english: Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel says: A month - Here it implies that an unqualified "month" is a defective month [of twenty-nine days]. And likewise in the chapter [entitled] Hamadir (Ketubot 71a), regarding: "A full month and a defective month are [the difference] between them." And this is difficult, for at the end of [the chapter entitled] HaCholetz (Yevamot 48b and there), we say: A month is thirty [days], days are thirty [days]. And likewise in the first chapter of Nazir (5a and there), [the Gemara] objects: "And say thirty [days], as it is written: 'Until a month of days' [Numbers 11:20]?" And one can say that the language of the Torah is distinct, and the language of the Sages is distinct. Alternatively: Here and in Hamadir, where the first tanna said "thirty," the matter proves that the other tanna [means] a defective month (and see further Tosafot, Ketubot 71a, s.v. Rabbi).

Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:7:1.hebrew: בת קול - יש אומרים שלא היו שומעין קול היוצא מן השמים, אלא מתוך אותו קול יוצא קול אחר — כמו פעמים שאדם מכה בכח ושומע קול אחר היוצא ממנו למרחוק; ואותו קול היו שומעין, לכך קורין אותו בת קול:
Tosafot on Sanhedrin 11a:7:1.english: A Divine Voice - Some say that they would not hear the voice that emanates from Heaven; rather, from within that voice another voice emanates — like times when a person strikes with force and hears another sound emanating from it in the distance — and that [secondary] sound they would hear. Therefore they call it a bat kol [literally, daughter of a voice].
